prompt: White fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Streetlamp Glow
irony: White the fixer who never switches off only lights the streetlamp when she stops fixing it and gives it a hug.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Dusk falls on the street as Green, Navy and White stand under the dark streetlamp.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants dinosaur pages under the light while White fusses with her toolbox and cannot stop fixing.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black shakes the pole on a dare and the lamp stays dark as night creeps closer.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends gather under the dark lamp and sing for its glow together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: White tightens wires and bulbs with every tool while Green corrects her and the light stays out.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The lamp flashes bright then pops dark again and White lands buried in her toolbox.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends hold hands under the dark lamp and sing for its glow again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White sings softly with Navy that our fixing hands feel tired and the street needs light, not more tools.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White puts the toolbox down and chooses a warm hug for the cold pole instead.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: White hugs the cold pole and warm light spills as friends sing the changed hook.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Friends hum the glow as dusk falls on the street again and the lit lamp shines on dinosaur pages.
